v3.8.4

Bugfixes

  • Added support for macOS 27 Golden Gate

v3.8.3

Improvements

  • Added icons for AirPods pro 3, AirPods 4 (ANC), AirPods Max (2024), Powerbeats Pro 2, Beats Solo Buds, Beats Studio Pro, Beats Studio Buds +
  • Classic Now Playing HUD is now shown on notch hover

Bugfixes

  • Fixed an issue where the now playing information would not update after a while using the system HUD
  • Fixed minimise option of iOS HUD style when liquid glass is enabled
  • Fixed system HUD classic style grow from edge transition

v3.8.2

Bugfixes

  • Fixed an issue where the HUD placement would behave incorrectly on macOS 26
  • Fixed an issue where the notch HUD would appear behind the menu bar on macOS 26
  • Fixed an issue where the HUD would not appear in fullscreen apps on macOS 26
  • Fixed an issue where notch hover would not work properly on macOS 26
  • Fixed an issue with demo mode on macOS 26

v3.8.1

Bugfixes

  • Fixed an issue where the iOS system HUD would be incorrectly styled pre-macOS 26
  • Fixed an issue where the notch HUD would appear behind the menu bar

v3.8.0

This release adds support for macOS 26

New Features

  • Liquid Glass option for all non-notch HUD styles
  • Customise how long system HUDs are visible

Improvements

  • Improved the layout of the classic now playing HUD
  • Text animates while switching songs
  • Improved overshoot animation for classic and iOS HUDs
  • Now Playing HUD is now not always shown on launch
  • Improved the classic Now Playing HUD transition

Bugfixes

  • Fixed an issue where the macOS system HUDs are visible while MediaMate is running on macOS 26
  • Fixed an issue where the settings window would appear incorrectly on macOS 26
  • Fixed an issue where the onboarding window would not appear on macOS 26
  • Fixed an issue where the system HUDs would flicker on macOS 26

Removed features

  • Removed the "Show background" option from the classic system HUD style.

Known issues

  • The onboarding window background might flicker on macOS 26

v3.7.1

IMPORTANT The previous behaviour of the now playing feature has been restored on macOS 15.4! It is off by default, but can be re-enabled by choosing the "system-wide" option in MediaMate settings.

Bugfixes

  • Fixed an issue with the "capture media keys" feature where pressing a media key would register it multiple times when external monitors are connected.
  • Fixed an issue where the app would consume more power when media is playing
  • Adjusted the default setting of the now playing music source (Spotify & Apple Music on by default instead of only Apple Music)

IMPORTANT

The previous behaviour of the now playing feature has been restored on macOS 15.4! It is off by default, but can be re-enabled by choosing the "system-wide" option in MediaMate settings.

Bugfixes

  • Restored support for system wide media info
  • Fixed an issue with the "capture media keys" feature where pressing a media key would register it multiple times when external monitors are connected.
  • Fixed an issue where the app would consume more power when media is playing
  • Adjusted the default setting of the now playing music source (Spotify & Apple Music on by default instead of only Apple Music)

IMPORTANT

This update fixes compatibility issues for the now playing feature on macOS 15.4. macOS 15.4 has restricted some APIs that MediaMate relied on for the now playing feature, resulting in the feature not working anymore. This new update uses another API to restore the functionality for Apple Music and Spotify. Support for other apps can be added later, but is not guaranteed, as not all apps support being controlled by another app. I'm also looking into restoring the old functionality.

New Features

  • Added an option to map the keyboard media keys exclusively to Apple Music and / or Spotify, instead of the last played app. For example, if you're listening to music and start watching a Youtube video, the keyboard controls will always control the music instead of switching over to controlling the Youtube video. Not all keyboards may be supported.

Bugfixes

  • Fixed now playing feature on macOS 15.4

Removed Features

  • The "Allowed apps" section has been removed, as it's not relevant for the new API.

Bugfixes

  • Fixed an issue where the settings could crash when opening the styles tab on recent macOS versions

v3.6.1

Bugfixes

  • Fixed a regression where the system HUDs would be shown on all screens.

v3.6.0

New Features

  • Added an option to show the Volume HUD when the Now Playing HUD is shown

Impovements

  • A new option has been added to the Notch section to adjust the virtual notch size if it doesn't match the physical notch size

Bugfixes

  • Fixed an issue where the HUD placement would not correctly respond to screen locking / unlocking
  • Fixed an issue where the iOS-themed HUD would not transition correctly with Blur transitions on macOS 15
  • Fixed an issue where a HUD preview would not disappear when closing the settings window on macOS 15
  • Fixed an issue where the Now Playing HUD would not work correctly with Orion browser
